description: Record a single step within a running trace. Captures tool name, input, output, optional token count and latency. Steps cannot be added after trace_end. Example: { "trace_id": "abc-123", "tool_name": "web_search", "input": {"query": "hello"}, "output": {"results": ["a","b"]}, "token_count": 50, "latency_ms": 320 }

input.description: Input payload passed to the tool. Example: { "query": "weather in Paris" }

latency_ms.description: Optional wall-clock latency of this step in milliseconds. Example: 450

output.description: Output/result returned by the tool. Example: { "result": "Sunny, 22°C" }. Add "error" field or "isError": true to flag errors.

token_count.description: Optional number of tokens consumed in this step. Example: 150

tool_name.description: Name of the tool or action that was executed. Example: "web_search" or "llm_call"

trace_id.description: ID of the trace to record this step under. Example: "abc-123-def-456"

name: trace_step
